summary: Frontend E2E of the vendor 'Add a product' form at /vendor/market as testvendor. Working: category picker from the master with add-new and case-insensitive dedupe; currency select from the master that switches to the country default (IN -> INR); Country -> State -> City cascade (IN has 36 states, Tamil Nadu has 394 cities); wrong ZIP rejected and valid ZIP saved; crop dialog for 2 files in a row (zoom, Use this photo, Fit automatically), both stored at 1200x900; edit form refills every field; submit works; after admin approval the public /market/:id page shows 'Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India'; AI fill from a PDF (about 15s) fills title, description with specs, category (with the 'not in the list yet' hint and an add link), unit, a 1200x900 photo and the spec sheet; catalogue import cards use the cat-category-N picker and add-new works there. Two defects: the ZIP placeholder never shows the country format, and the Description textarea is squashed to one line.

ui_bugs.issue: Placeholder always reads 'ZIP / postal code' and never shows the format (expected 'ZIP (######)' for IN). RCA: useCountries() calls /api/v1/meta/countries, and that endpoint does not return postal_code_format or postal_code_regex. The data exists in db.masters_countries (IN: format '######', regex '^\d{6}$'). Save-time validation still works because the backend reads masters_countries.

The textarea is 40px tall (one line) even though it has rows={4}. Cause: '.pmc-input { height: 40px }' in pmc-theme-e.css. Text filled in by AI (description plus 'Specifications:' bullets) is mostly hidden unless the user scrolls inside the box. The catalogue import cards (cat-desc-N, rows=5) have the same problem.

issues: The ZIP error toast reads 'Something went wrong · HTTP 400' followed by 'ZIP / postal code should look like ######'. The generic prefix is unhelpful, and '######' is unclear to non-technical users; something like '6 digits, e.g. 600001' would be clearer.

When a country is picked but no state, the city list loads only the first 500 cities of the whole country, because of limit=500 (India has about 4300). Consider disabling City until a state is chosen when the country has states.

Crop dialog with a very tall image (600x1400): with contain-fit the 4:3 crop box is sized to the narrow image width, so it looks small. This works, but consider objectFit='horizontal-cover' or a minimum crop size.
Closing the crop dialog with X or Esc calls onSkip, which still uploads the photo (auto-fit). There is no way to cancel one photo from the queue.

action_items: Return postal_code_format (and optionally postal_code_regex) from /api/v1/meta/countries, or have LocationPicker read the masters countries endpoint, so the ZIP placeholder shows the country format
Give textareas that use .pmc-input auto height (e.g. 'textarea.pmc-input{height:auto;padding:8px 12px}' or className 'h-auto py-2') so rows={4} and rows={5} take effect
Optional: clearer ZIP hint text; require a state before loading cities; let the user cancel a queued photo in the crop dialog

Optional: CategoryPicker keeps its categories in per-instance state seeded from the module cache _cats. A category added in one catalogue-import card does not show up in the other cards' dropdowns until they remount. Share the list through a small store or event.
critical_code_review_comments: MarketFormPickers.jsx: the module-level _cats cache never refreshes, so categories PMC switches off or adds stay stale until a full page reload.
PhotoCropDialog: onOpenChange(false) leads to onSkip, which uploads the photo, so the user has no way to discard it.
LocationPicker: state and city lists fail silently (catch sets []), so a network error looks the same as 'No states listed'.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (all requested flows work; 2 medium UI defects)
